about_the_game:
Synopsis:

Quiet Classroom is a dramatic visual novel with touches of humor. It tells the story of four troubled orphans enrolled in a rehabilitation program known as the "Quiet Classroom."

You play as Haruto Saito, a former Japanese soldier and World War III veteran. After being wounded in combat, Haruto returns home, only to face the threat of forced treatment in a veteran care facility due to his struggle to adjust to civilian life. But everything changes when a mysterious stranger offers him an alternative: to become a mentor in the Quiet Classroom.

Can Haruto help these four teenagers—and himself—confront the demons of their past? That’s up to you.

Features:

◼ Fully voiced in Russian (including the protagonist’s inner thoughts) by the renowned dubbing studio RavenCat, known for its work on numerous popular titles — including the hit Russian visual novel Tiny Bunny (Zaychik).

◼ Over 100 original illustrations created by top-tier artists:
— Animated backgrounds by dankalaning
— High-quality character sprites with a wide range of emotions by hehehell
— Animated CG scenes by artsam

◼ A dynamic, branching narrative with more than five major story paths shaped by your choices — inspired by the tone and spirit of classic anime, with multiple secret endings to uncover.

◼ A rich, emotional soundtrack crafted by experienced composers — blending peaceful school-day tunes with the intense, chaotic sound of war.

The Students:

Yuto Nakajima — a typical delinquent and former gang member.

Can you find a way to get along with him?

Rin Miyamoto — a quiet, cautious girl with a painful past.

Will you recognize the danger in time to earn her trust?

Kenta Suzuki — a friendly, easygoing guy.

He shouldn’t cause any trouble... right?

Emiko Yamashita — a shy, sweet girl with a rich inner world.

Will you dare to help her bring it to light?
